title: Word to World for Cursor - language layer (schemaVersion 1)
description: Keys are the exact English text shown on screen (trimmed). Values are display translations. The authoritative checker is `node tools/pack.js validate` (it also checks placeholders, duplicates and do-not-translate terms).

lang.description: vscode-loc id, lowercase (ja, zh-cn, pt-br). Must equal the file name (ja -> ja.json). English is the base and has no language layer.

name.description: Language name in English. The display name is Word to World for Cursor | <name> Language Layer.

nativeName.description: Language name in the language itself

cursorVersion.description: Cursor version the language layer was most recently checked against

verifiedCursorVersions.description: Cursor versions this language layer has been checked against (e.g. 3.28.7, 3.30.14)

patterns.description: Keys contain {0}, {1}...; the translation must contain the same placeholders.

area.description: settings = inside/near Cursor Settings; agents = Agents window chrome; editor = editor (IDE) window chrome. --scope settings keeps only 'settings'.

deny.description: CSS selector: never translate inside it (user data such as chat/project rows)

attrs.description: attributes translated in this group (default: none outside settings)

patterns.description: like top-level patterns ({0} placeholders), only inside this group

bypassDeny.description: apply even inside the global deny list (only for narrow selectors such as a chat row's time stamp; never titles)

via.description: css-placeholder: keys are data-placeholder values of an empty editor paragraph; drawn by a CSS rule, the editor DOM is never changed
